strings.libcamera는 Linux, Android, ChromeOS를 위한: libcamera is an open-source library for supporting complex cameras on Linux, Android, and ChromeOS. It connects to Linux kernel device drivers and provides developers with an intuitive API, simplifying the complex task of capturing images with complex cameras on Linux systems. Providing a functioning camera stack using the drivers is the responsibility of user space, and vendors have typically implemented it independently, without a common architecture or API for application developers. This work is complex because hardware pipelines and the way they are represented in kernel APIs vary, often requiring custom handling.
